what_it_does: SQ-DM accelerates diffusion models (neural networks that generate images by progressively refining noise) using aggressive 4-bit number compression and selective sparsity (skipping computation on small values). The challenge: sparsity patterns change dynamically across different channels and timesteps during inference. SQ-DM builds a hardware accelerator with channel-specific sparse handling and timestep-aware detection to exploit these dynamic patterns efficiently.
